name: El Professor

tenures.role: a thirty-year veteran of the lucha circuit who walks to the ring in a tweed jacket; won the #1 contendership for the Baja Blast Championship Sponsored by Taco Bell
tenures.source: promotions/adw/archive/ (the promoter's own play notes, served W9)

caption: A thirty-year veteran of the lucha circuit, tweed jacket and all, who fought The Void to a Steel Cage draw and back across ADW's one surviving season to claim the #1 contendership for the Baja Blast Championship Sponsored by Taco Bell.

name: El Triton

tenures.role: a mountain in a lucha mask who speaks only in screams and carries his baby with him into the ring; won the vacant Baja Blast Championship Sponsored by Taco Bell in a three-way, then defended it against Gavin Firebrand at Run for the Border
tenures.source: promotions/adw/archive/ (the promoter's own play notes, served W9)

caption: A mountain of a man in a lucha mask who speaks only in screams and carries his baby into the ring — and, in the one season ADW ran, its Baja Blast Champion Sponsored by Taco Bell, defending the belt against the man who kidnapped his own son.

name: Rory Borealis

tenures.role: a hillbilly from Michigan's Upper Peninsula who got high, got lost, and ended up in the southwest
tenures.source: promotions/adw/archive/ (the promoter's own play notes, served W9)

caption: A hillbilly from Michigan's Upper Peninsula who got high, got lost, and somehow wound up wrestling in the ADW desert — and, at the Run for the Border PPV, beat a former five-time champion clean.

name: The Void

tenures.role: a 6'4" "brick shithouse"; entrant in the season-opening 6-way tag match, cost El Professor the three-way for the vacant title by interference, fought El Professor to a Steel Cage draw for the #1 contendership, then lost the Run for the Border rematch to end the surviving record

caption: A "brick shithouse" of a wrestler whose interference cost El Professor the vacant Baja Blast Championship, then fought him to a Steel Cage draw and back for the #1 contendership across ADW's one surviving season.

name: Gail Storm

identity.note: "Storm" is a common ring-name element; no evidence beyond the shared word links this ADW entrant to any other registry row billed as/aka "Storm" — a wholly separate wing (tabletop, 2021), no shared handler or continuity evidence on file.

tenures.role: a technical wrestler; entrant in the season-opening 6-way tag match, teamed with The Void and Ras Trent

caption: A technical wrestler who teamed with The Void and Ras Trent in the six-way tag match that opened ADW's one surviving season.

name: Ras Trent

tenures.role: a high college kid; entrant in the season-opening 6-way tag match, teamed with The Void and Gail Storm

caption: A "high college kid" who teamed with The Void and Gail Storm in the six-way tag match that opened ADW's one surviving season.

name: Gavin Firebrand

tenures.role: a fire-and-brimstone preacher character, billed as the Right Reverend; feuded with El Triton across both surviving sessions over the Baja Blast Championship and El Triton's own kidnapped son, losing the title match at Run for the Border

caption: A fire-and-brimstone preacher billed as the Right Reverend, who kidnapped El Triton's son and fought him for the Baja Blast Championship at Run for the Border — and lost.

name: Dag Boomer

identity.note: The substring collision is purely orthographic — "Error" happens to appear inside "Terror" — with no other shared evidence; a wholly separate wing (tabletop, 2021), no shared handler or continuity evidence on file.

tenures.role: a former five-time Baja Blast Champion Sponsored by Taco Bell; challenged Rory Borealis across both surviving sessions, an unresolved match in the season recap followed by a clean pinfall loss at Run for the Border

caption: A former five-time Baja Blast Champion Sponsored by Taco Bell whose comeback bid against Rory Borealis ran through both of ADW's surviving sessions — and ended in a clean loss at Run for the Border.

name: Ed Johnson

tenures.role: Commissioner; broke up a backstage brawl between El Triton and Gavin Firebrand's deacons at Run for the Border

caption: ADW's on-screen Commissioner, seen once wrangling a backstage brawl between El Triton and the Right Reverend Gavin Firebrand's deacons into the ring.
